summary: On May 11, 2026, Inspira Technologies OXY B.H.N. Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release in which its CEO issued a shareholder letter outlining the company's strategic direction and value creation plan. The letter describes three value tracks: a commercially active Additively Manufactured Electronics platform, a quantum connectivity program, and a medical business positioned as a wholly owned subsidiary. No transactional terms (price, premium, stake, date) are provided. The filing is a routine strategic update with no binding offer, board recommendation, or structural mechanics. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or going-private transaction. This is an ordinary communication of strategy and should not be classified as a special situation.
